code:
kubectl apply -k "github.com/kubeflow/training-operator/manifests/overlays/standalone"

# capstone-pytorchjob.yaml
spec:
  pytorchReplicaSpecs:
    Master:
      replicas: 1
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
            - command: ["torchrun", "--nnodes=4",
                         "--nproc_per_node=1", "train.py"]
    Worker:
      replicas: 3
      template: { ... same container ... }
caption: Drop nvidia.com/gpu from resources entirely to run this CPU-only.

eyebrow: Injected automatically — don't set these yourself
code:
dist.init_process_group(backend="nccl")  # "gloo" for CPU-only
rank = dist.get_rank()
world_size = dist.get_world_size()
# world_size == 4, distinct rank per pod -> genuinely distributed

model = FSDP(model)
dcp.save({"model": model.state_dict()},
         checkpoint_id="s3://your-bucket/capstone-checkpoints/step-500")
caption: MASTER_ADDR, MASTER_PORT, RANK, and WORLD_SIZE come from the Training Operator, not from you.
